exposure: Remote/telehealth model for clinical trial intervention delivery
cohort: The study involved caregivers interviewed about enrollment barriers, and observed enrollment outcomes for infants with Tuberous Sclerosis Complex (TSC) participating in a clinical trial.
finding: Implementing a remote, at-home intervention model with weekly video conferencing substantially increased clinical trial enrollment tenfold within one year and resulted in a more diverse and clinically representative cohort of infants.
